explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in body context, then walked tokens with `next_token()` and wrapped only ordinary `#text` tokens whose decoded text from `get_modifiable_text()` contains the keyword. Each token is emitted with `serialize_token()` so the result stays normalized, with `<mark>` added only around matching text nodes; if parsing cannot be created or later aborts, the function falls back to normalized output when available.
